hebrew:
יוֹם קָדוֹשׁ וּמְבֹרָךְ מִכָּל־הַיָּמִים אֵל בָּחַרְתָּ׃
הוּא יוֹם שַׁבָּת שֶׁמְּלֶאכֶת עוֹלָמִים בּוֹ גָּמַרְתָּ׃
וּנְתַתּוֹ לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי לָהֶם אָתָּה קִדַּשְׁתָּ׃
הִיא חֶמְדָּה גְּנוּזָה שֶׁבּוֹ יִשְׂמַח מֹשֶׁה וְעַמּוֹ תִּכַּנְתָּ׃
אַתָּה אֶחָד וּלְעַם מְיֻחָד שֶׁמִירָתוֹ לָהֶם פָּקַדְתָּ׃

translation:
A holy and blessed day, above all other days, which You have chosen, O God.
It is the Sabbath, the day on which You completed the work of the world.
And You gave it to the children of Israel, for You have sanctified it for them.
It is a hidden treasure in which You have ordained that Moses and his people should rejoice.
You are One, and to a chosen people whose protection You have ordained for them.
